description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and sparsity ratio. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 25, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A dashed orange line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate average 0.003”, begins at approximately 0.8 and decreases to approximately 0.3 by layer 25. A dotted light blue line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate average 0.126”, begins at approximately 0.6 and decreases to approximately 0.25 by layer 25. A dashed green line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate average 0.080”, begins at approximately 0.2 and remains relatively steady around 0.3 from layer 5 to layer 25.
